## Linked issue and result
Use `Refs #N` for preparation/partial work; `Closes #N` only for complete task acceptance.
Describe the delivered result, not the entire parent capability.

## Scope and interfaces
- New/modified files and affected consumers:
- Dependencies/base branch and planned integration order:
- Out-of-scope changes intentionally excluded:

## Approval evidence
Link the written specification, approved plan/design and explicit execution scope.
An issue assignment, dependency closure or board movement is not authorization.

## Verification
- Behavioral RED/GREEN evidence for implementation:
- Fresh root tests/vet after review; exact command/toolchain/result:
- Documentation-only checks, if applicable:
- Unsupported cases, incomplete checks and remaining producer/native/release gates:

## Collaboration and safety
- [ ] Scope/ownership agreed; shared interface overlap communicated.
- [ ] No unapproved dependencies/downloads, target execution or investigated-tree writes.
- [ ] No credentials, private keys, session state or investigated data in this PR.
- [ ] Findings/evidence and coverage are not conflated; uncertainty is retained.
- [ ] Second-person review requested before integration.
- [ ] Integration will update issue evidence and Project status/blockers manually.

See [collaboration guide](https://github.com/landroval/PackTrace/blob/development/docs/github-collaboration.md).
